hypothesis: The stable 103/105 memetic state can be completed by replacing only row 0 with a full six-mark Golomb ruler while retaining rows 1 through 6.
rationale: In the 103 state, rows 1 through 6 are mutually difference-disjoint and all two duplicate differences involve row 0. This makes full replacement of row 0 a sharply bounded exact decomposition, stronger than the previously exhausted one/two-coordinate neighborhood. The fixed six rows occupy 90 unique differences, leaving only 21 admissible differences for the replacement row's 15 differences.
expected_information_gain: A compatible replacement row gives a directly validator-checkable scope-111 DTS. Exhausting the replacement-row search with no result closes the entire one-row repair basin of the best memetic state, not merely a coordinate neighborhood, while making no global infeasibility claim.
method: Compile research_tools/search_dts_full_row_completion.cpp with WSL2 g++ -O3. Hold the six rows [1..6] of the exact 103-state fixed. Build their 90-difference mask, recursively enumerate every normalized six-mark row with marks in 0..111 whose 15 positive differences avoid the fixed mask and are mutually distinct, and stop at the first complete compatible row. Emit the exact node and complete-row counts and independently validate any assembled seven-row result with research_tools/verify_dts.py and research_tools/verify_dts_independent.py.
metric: Fixed-row unique difference count, admissible difference count, exhaustive recursion nodes, compatible complete-row count, and independent validator result
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A compatible complete replacement accepted by both independent integer verifiers is exactly the frozen true objective. Exhaustive failure is finite basin evidence only.

configuration.enumeration: complete recursive normalized-row enumeration with fixed-mask and within-row pruning

kill_condition: Stop at the first compatible complete row and preserve it for independent validation, or after the recursive enumeration proves no compatible row exists. Do not infer global DTS infeasibility from this fixed-six decomposition.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only if an independent validator accepts a completed row set

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: full-row replacement tests a materially broader basin than the exhaustive one/two-coordinate audit

interpretation: The exact full-row enumeration against rows 1 through 6 completed after 108 recursion nodes and found zero compatible six-mark rows. The six fixed rows occupy 90 unique differences, leaving 21 admissible differences, but no 15-difference Golomb ruler can be formed from them.
what_was_learned: The reproducible memetic 103/105 state cannot be repaired by changing only row 0, even with an exhaustive full-domain row search. This is stronger finite closure than the prior one/two-coordinate neighborhood and does not imply global DTS infeasibility.
recommended_next_action: Use the separately preregistered exact three-row completion against the four rows not implicated by the two conflicts; avoid repeating one-row or shallow coordinate repair.
repetition_justification: This is not a repeat of the prior clamped-witness one-row replacement: it uses a different, newly discovered 103 state whose six fixed rows are mutually compatible. It also searches every possible replacement row rather than a coordinate neighborhood or sampled row library.
